deliverables: Performance budget enforced at every layer
approach: Discovery & content audit
IA and wireframes
Build in a typed, component-based stack
Performance and accessibility QA
Launch and handover

services.valueProp: A mobile app scoped to match your actual reach and budget: cross-platform where it fits, native where performance calls for it.
services.problem: Choosing between cross-platform and native affects your cost, timeline, and performance, so it helps to have that tradeoff explained clearly before you commit.
deliverables: App Store and Google Play submission support
approach: Platform and architecture decision (cross-platform vs native)
UX flows and prototyping
Development in sprints with staging builds
Device and OS-version QA
Store submission and launch

services.title: Custom Systems (CMS / ERP)
services.shortDescription: Internal tools and systems shaped around how your team already works, so day-to-day operations run smoother.

Migration, launch, and training

services.title: UI/UX & System Redesign
services.shortDescription: A hard look at your existing site, app, or internal system, followed by a redesign that fixes what's actually costing you users or time.
services.valueProp: Most redesigns fail because they change the look without fixing the workflow. We audit what's actually broken first, then redesign around real usage, not guesswork.
services.problem: An aging site or internal tool that's slow, confusing, or was never designed for how the business actually works today, and needs more than a fresh coat of paint.
deliverables: UX audit of the current site, app, or system
Migration plan that protects existing data and SEO
Updated component system for consistent future changes
approach: Audit: map what's broken, slow, or confusing in the current build
Redesign: new UI/UX and structure based on real usage, not guesswork
Rebuild: implement in a typed, component-based stack
Migrate: move content and data across without breaking what works
Launch: staged rollout with before/after comparison

faq.question: Do we lose our existing content or SEO rankings?
faq.answer: No. Migration is planned around preserving URLs, redirects, and existing content, so search rankings carry over rather than reset.

faq.question: What if we just want a visual refresh, not a full rebuild?
faq.answer: That's fine. The audit tells us how deep the problem actually goes; some projects only need new UI on the existing structure.

services.title: AI Development

services.valueProp: AI integrated where it meaningfully improves your workflow or product, with clear boundaries between AI integration and custom ML.

Architecture design (integration vs custom model)
Build with evaluation harness
Staged rollout with monitoring
Tuning and iteration post-launch

Ongoing maintenance cycle
Quarterly review and roadmap

services.title: Digital Marketing
services.shortDescription: SEO, paid ads, and social media management that bring the right customers to your business consistently.
services.valueProp: A marketing setup that brings the right people to your business consistently, with the follow-through to turn that traffic into results.

deliverables: Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign setup and management

Monthly analytics report with actionable insights
approach: Audit current digital presence and competitors
Define target audience and channel priorities
Build and launch campaigns with tracking in place
Optimise weekly based on data
Monthly review and roadmap

faq.question: How long before I see results?
faq.answer: SEO typically shows traction in 3-6 months. Paid ads can deliver leads from week one. We set realistic expectations per channel in the initial strategy call.

faq.question: Do you manage ads or just set them up?
faq.answer: We do both: setup and ongoing management with weekly optimisation. One-time setup without management rarely performs well.

services.title: Business Growth
services.shortDescription: Growth strategy and go-to-market planning that helps you reach the right customers at the right time.
services.valueProp: A clear, executable growth plan built around your actual market and stage, so you grow in the direction that makes sense for your business.
services.problem: Knowing what to build is often the easy part. Positioning it, pricing it, and reaching the right customers at the right time is where most startups and SMEs need the most help.
approach: Discovery: understand your business, customers, and market
Research: competitive landscape and positioning gaps
Strategy: define positioning, channels, and targets
Plan: 90-day execution roadmap with milestones
Review: measure, iterate, and re-plan quarterly

faq.question: Is this consulting or execution?
faq.answer: Primarily strategy and planning, but we stay involved through the execution phase to make sure the plan is actually implemented. We don't hand you a deck and disappear.

faq.question: Do you work with pre-revenue startups?
faq.answer: Yes. The approach adjusts: pre-revenue focuses on validation and GTM; post-revenue focuses on scaling what's working and fixing what's not.

Social media post templates (Canva or Figma)

faq.answer: Yes, all final files in AI, EPS, PNG, and SVG formats, plus your brand guide as a PDF and editable Figma/Canva templates.

faq.answer: Yes. We do studio tabletop shoots for products and on-location shoots where the environment adds to the story.

faq.answer: For studio shoots, yes: we arrange collection or delivery within the Klang Valley. For bulky products or venue-based businesses, we shoot on-location at your premises.

faq.question: Can I use the photos anywhere?
faq.answer: Yes. You receive full usage rights to all final images, delivered in high resolution plus web-optimised and platform-specific crops.

services.title: Media Creation

faq.answer: Both. On-site for product, brand, and interview content; remote/screen-capture for tutorials, SaaS demos, and webinars.

faq.question: How many revisions are included?
faq.answer: Two rounds of edit revisions are included per video. We structure briefs well upfront to reduce revision cycles.

faq.question: Do you help with the grant application itself?
faq.answer: Yes. We help assess eligibility and prepare the application, then deliver the actual digital project once the grant is approved.
